title: НА + accusative: For a week, the next day

blocks.text: НА + Accusative indicates how long something is expected to last.

items.head: The preposition НА + Acc. is used:
points: to indicate the length of time one expects to stay some place, or the time something is expected to last
after the verb опаздывать / опоздать to indicate the amount of time by which someone is late

items.text: Note also such expressions as: на следующий день — (next day).

blocks.text: DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 73. One sentence at a time, in a new order each time you open this chapter; it is finished when every one has been answered right. The sentences are real: the source of each is shown with it.

exercises.prompt: At night, she puts on hair curlers.
exercises.why: **ночь → ночь** (acc. sg.). На + accusative: how long something is expected to last. Feminine. Declines like часть. Accusative = nominative.

exercises.q: Нам придётся удвоить наш бюджет на ___ (следующий год).
exercises.prompt: We'll have to double our budget for next year.
exercises.why: **год → год** (acc. sg.). На + accusative: how long something is expected to last. Masculine, inanimate. Declines like дом. Accusative = nominative.  **следующий → следующий** (acc. sg. m., agreeing with год). Declines like хороший. Accusative = nominative.

exercises.prompt: We can accommodate him for the night.
exercises.why: **ночь → ночь** (acc. sg.). На + accusative: how long something is expected to last. Feminine. Declines like часть. Accusative = nominative.

exercises.prompt: I was distracted for a moment.
exercises.why: **секунда → секунду** (acc. sg.: на + accusative). Feminine. Declines like газета. Ending -а → -у.

exercises.prompt: Will you put us up for one night?
exercises.why: **ночь → ночь** (acc. sg.). На + accusative: how long something is expected to last. Feminine. Declines like часть. Accusative = nominative.  **один → одну** (acc. sg. f., agreeing with ночь). «один» has its own declension (not the regular adjective pattern).
**секунда → секунду** (acc. sg.: на + accusative). Feminine. Declines like газета. Ending -а → -у.

exercises.prompt: He chopped firewood for the winter.
exercises.why: **зима → зиму** (acc. sg.). На + accusative: how long something is expected to last. Feminine. Declines like газета. Ending -а → -у.

exercises.prompt: I have a reservation for two nights.
exercises.why: **две ночи** — 2–4, 22–24, 32–34… (not 12–14) take the genitive singular (ночь → ночи); 1, 21, 31… take the nominative singular.

exercises.q: Прилет самолета в Гонолулу намечен на ___ (завтрашнее утро).
exercises.prompt: The airplane is scheduled to arrive at Honolulu tomorrow morning.
exercises.why: **утро → утро** (acc. sg.). На + accusative: how long something is expected to last. Neuter. Declines like окно. Accusative = nominative.  **завтрашний → завтрашнее** (acc. sg. n., agreeing with утро). Declines like синий. Accusative = nominative.

exercises.prompt: He put me up for a night.
exercises.why: **ночь → ночь** (acc. sg.). На + accusative: how long something is expected to last. Feminine. Declines like часть. Accusative = nominative.  **один → одну** (acc. sg. f., agreeing with ночь). «один» has its own declension (not the regular adjective pattern).
